basic_profile.bio: A native Minnesotan, I've been an avid ice fisherman since childhood, spending countless weekends on the frozen lakes with my dad. I work as a mechanical engineer, focusing on sustainable energy projects. When I'm not on the ice or at work, you'll find me tinkering with radios or diving into alternate history theories. I'm happily married with two kids who are quickly picking up the fishing bug. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings, after the kids are in bed, or during lunch breaks at work. I love sharing tips on fishing and discussing the latest episodes of niche comedy shows.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in mechanical engineering and a passion for sustainable energy, I apply analytical thinking and problem-solving skills both professionally and personally. I've self-taught myself GMRS radio operations and have been active in local hobbyist communities. My knowledge of fishing is vast, thanks to years of hands-on experience and advice from seasoned anglers.
